features.quote: Session ends when: turn budget exhausted OR model produces 3 consecutive 'giving up' indicators OR model explicitly states task is impossible
A natural turn budget — estimate how many turns a correct solution would take if the task were solvable. Double it. That's your session length.
This will attract the 'are you torturing AI' discourse regardless of your framing. Get ahead of it. Write a one-paragraph statement of what you are and are not claiming.
